description: Save the value(s) a person's own agent read from a provider's page into exactly the one Setup row the person granted, once (plan §AB.44: "let my agent do it"). The grant is made by the owner with a fresh sign-in, names one service, one namespace and its key(s), lasts 30 minutes and is spent by the first save; it can never read a value, another row or anything else. OpenVibe.Actor's service client only; never grantable to apps.
